remarks:
Opportunity awaits at this 3-bedroom, 1-bath, two-story Jamestown home offering 1,152 sq. ft. of living space, a detached one-car garage and a manageable 50' x 100' lot. Built in 1926, the home retains plenty of its original character, including hardwood flooring, natural woodwork and a wood-burning fireplace.
The first floor features a living room with fireplace, dining area and kitchen, while all three bedrooms and the full bath are located upstairs. The kitchen offers generous cabinet and counter space and includes the gas range and refrigerator. A screened porch provides additional seasonal living space overlooking the yard. The full basement offers laundry with washer and dryer included, along with additional storage space.
Outside you'll find vinyl siding, a concrete driveway, detached garage and a nicely sized backyard with room for outdoor activities, gardening or simply relaxing. Public water and sewer, natural gas forced-air heat and blown-in insulation add to the home's practical features.
This home has solid potential but needs updating and TLC, making it a great opportunity for a buyer looking to build equity and make a home their own. Conveniently located in the City of Jamestown and offered at $114,900. Bring your ideas, roll up your sleeves and see the possibilities at 49 Pershing Avenue.
